name: Hozuki: Latent Made of Water I

system.description:
Bloodline Point Cost: 2

(You must have Latent Lightning Release Inability) Beginning at 3rd level your body counts as a sufficient source of water to reduce the cost of Water release jutsu. You cannot gain the alternative effect of a Water release jutsu using this feature. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.
